Those two pages do not use the same figure.

The Summer 2026 dinner menu says peanut oil is commonly used in the kitchen, and it also names olive oil and butter on particular dishes. Those lines are not one fat for every plate, so Tortuga does not score the kitchen from the menu.

offerings.note: The Summer 2026 dinner menu lists steak frites as pan-seared flat iron steak, caramelized shallots, and maître d’hôtel butter, served with French fries. The same menu says peanut oil is commonly used in the kitchen and does not say which fat the fries are cooked in.

offerings.name: Roasted leg of lamb
offerings.note: The Summer 2026 dinner menu lists roasted leg of lamb with ratatouille, crispy panisse, and extra virgin olive oil. That is one dish, not a claim about the rest of the menu.

offerings.name: Truite amandine

sourcedNotes.text: The Summer 2026 dinner menu says peanut oil is commonly used in the kitchen.

The same Summer 2026 menu names extra virgin olive oil on the roasted leg of lamb, maître d’hôtel butter on steak frites, beurre noisette on the trout and the white sausage, and parsley-garlic butter on the snails. It does not name one cooking fat for every dish.

places.hoursNote: Copied from the official Caesars Palace contact page on November 10, 2026: Sunday–Thursday 5pm–10pm, Friday–Saturday 5pm–11pm. Hours change.
places.coordinateNote: The pin is the OpenStreetMap indoor room named Nobu, tagged as a restaurant, on Jay Sarno Way inside Caesars Palace. That room does not carry the boulevard number. The street address and phone are from Nobu’s contact page.
places.summary: Nobu’s restaurant at Caesars Palace, at the address on the company’s contact page. The restaurant page describes shared dishes, including yellowtail with jalapeño and black cod miso. It does not name a cooking fat, so Tortuga does not score the kitchen.

places.name: Jaleo at The Cosmopolitan
places.address: 3708 Las Vegas Boulevard South, Las Vegas, NV 89109
places.hoursNote: Copied from The Cosmopolitan’s Jaleo page on November 10, 2026: Monday–Thursday 5:00pm–10:00pm, Friday–Saturday 5:00pm–11:00pm, Sunday 5:00pm–10:00pm. The José Andrés Group location page lists the same address and phone and does not print those hours. Hours change.
places.coordinateNote: The pin is the OpenStreetMap node named Jaleo. That node does not repeat the boulevard number. The street address is from the José Andrés Group location page, which places the restaurant inside The Cosmopolitan.
places.summary: José Andrés Group’s Jaleo inside The Cosmopolitan. The location page gives the address and says the centerpiece is an open-fire wood grill for paella. It does not name a cooking oil, so the grill is not treated as a fat finding and the place stays unrated.
